gaps.sentence: The government made a formal ___ (DECLARE) of intent to invest in rail.
gaps.explanation: 'A formal declaration' — the noun follows the adjective.

gaps.sentence: The ___ (OWN) of the car park charges by the hour.
gaps.explanation: 'The owner' — the person who owns it; 'ownership' is the state.

gaps.hint: noun: the state of being free from rule
gaps.explanation: 'Gain independence' = become self-governing; the noun form follows the verb.

gaps.sentence: He has a wide ___ (KNOW) of local history.
She beat three hundred ___ (COMPETE) for the title.
gaps.hint: plural noun: the people she beat
gaps.explanation: 'Three hundred competitors' — plural noun for the people taking part.

gaps.sentence: The manager praised the team for its ___ (COMMIT) to quality.
gaps.explanation: The noun from COMMIT is 'commitment' — a dedication to a course of action.
